description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the VacancyDao class within the Recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests CRUD operations and filtering methods for Vacancy entities.

classes.name: VacancyDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing VacancyDao methods including CRUD operations and filtering in the recruitment context.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes VacancyDao instance and populates test data fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveVacancy
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new Vacancy entity.

methods.name: testGetVacancyById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a Vacancy by its ID.

methods.name: testUpdateVacancy
methods.description: Tests updating an existing Vacancy entity.

methods.name: testDeleteVacancies
methods.description: Tests deleting Vacancies by their IDs.

methods.name: testGetVacancies
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of Vacancies with default filters.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByJobTitle
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by Job Title ID.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by specific Vacancy IDs.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by Hiring Manager employee number.

methods.name: testGetVacanciesFilterByStatus
methods.description: Tests filtering Vacancies by their status.

methods.name: testGetVacancyListGroupByHiringManager
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of hiring manager employee numbers for specific vacancies.

methods.name: testSearchVacanciesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of Vacancies matching certain filters.
